description: Preliminary double-difference relocation earthquake catalogue for southwestern Yukon centred along the Denali fault zone is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of Yukon | Gouvernement du Yukon. Southwestern Yukon is a seismically active zone of crustal deformation including multiple large, dextral strike-slip fault systems with overlapping activity. In this study, we perform double-difference relocation to the USGS earthquake catalogue for this region to produce a relocated catalogue of 5536 seismic events above magnitude 1.5 from 2010–2021. Coverage: Government of Yukon. The portal files it under the publisher Government of Yukon | Gouvernement du Yukon. Its tags are ygs-import, ygs-import-20250711, ygs-publications, yukon-geological-survey, importation d'ygs. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, HTML, PDF. The portal shows 2026-08-26 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Yukon. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
